unit.why: A single anecdote: when the child R. David Moshe (son of the Ruzhiner) was seven, a fire broke out in the Ruzhin court and he would not interrupt his bedtime blessing; he signalled that God would save them, and the fire went out.

stories.start_quote: ספרו מגידי אמת שבעת שהי׳ כבן שבע שנים
stories.summary_en: As a seven-year-old, R. David Moshe stays in bed during a fire at his father's court in Ruzhin, refusing to interrupt after reciting the bedtime blessing; he signals that God will save them, and immediately the fire is extinguished.

quotes: ויצא הריזינער מחדרו ושאל על ילדיו
tags.why: The Ruzhiner and his children appear; the protagonist is his son.
The fire is extinguished at once, after his assurance.
He signals that God will save them, and it comes true.
The text frames the tale as showing the holiness of the tzaddik from childhood.
The household is saved from the fire.

quotes: כבר בירך ברכת „המפיל חבלי שינה" ואינו רוצה להפסיק
tags.why: His steadfastness concerns the bedtime blessing.
